comparison_assumption: Revised simulation errors use independent full-collision sample covariance; reference-curve covariance is estimated from local fluctuations. Historical proxy tables are retained separately. Neither finite covariance rank nor estimated reference exposure supports an unqualified global chi-square.
native_reproducibility: Cards preserve all executable statements. A later executable can change stochastic consumption or corrected physics; recorded output is tied to origin_source_revision. Byte equality is not promised across revisions or compilers.
